universal_patterns.pattern: this part governs the licensure[^.]*professions and occupations governed by this title

proposal.rationale: Reviewed the 10 undetermined sections. All of them are in Title 37, Chapter 2 ("General Provisions Relating to Health Care Practitioners") — they regulate medical practitioners, drug companies, pharmacy interactions, prescriptions, and peer review committees. These are NOT universal occupational provisions; they are scoped to health care practitioners (medicine, dentistry, osteopathy, podiatry, optometry, pharmacy, nursing — as defined in 37-2-101's "medical practitioner"). They should remain undetermined / surface in triage rather than being swept in as universal. The "as used in this part" phrasing in 37-2-101 is already handled by the cross-state walker, but the part itself is profession-specific (health care practitioners only), not title-wide. Section 37-2-202 references "chapter 3, 4, 7, or 8" but only in the context of medical assistance programs for licensees of those specific health-care chapters — not a universal enumeration. Keeping patterns unchanged so these surface for manual review rather than being falsely classified as universal.
